mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an extremely accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with a strong increase in payroll employment, signals a tight labor market and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low unemployment and strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a decrease in supply, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when industrial production is below 95 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the federal funds rate is above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate, combined with a weak increase in payroll employment, signals a loose labor market and potential deflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high unemployment and weak payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when retail sales are above 400000 (t-test p > 0.05).
